sources.title: Åtgärder mot manipulering av viss fordonsutrustning – avgasrening och vägmätare
sources.excerpt: Katalysatorn förutsätter att avgastemperaturen kommer upp till en given nivå
sources.supports: Temperature/light-off threshold; three-way petrol catalyst reduces CO/HC/NOx; conversion products include CO2/water.
sources.scope_limits: Conventional petrol three-way catalyst; cold-start weakness corroborated by TRV road-air opening. No universal warm-up time/temperature, no implication diesel catalysts work identically, no use of 2022 legislative proposals as current law.
sources.retrieval_method: Exact primary official page or PDF passage inspected with web tools

sources.title: Vägtrafikens luftföroreningar
sources.locator: Opening; Påverkan på hälsan; Partiklar; Kväveoxid; Kolmonoxid
sources.excerpt: Kolmonoxid binds hårdare till blodets hemoglobin än vad syre gör
sources.supports: CO prevents oxygen transport; particles harm airways; NOx irritates mucous membranes and contributes to acidification; NOx+hydrocarbons+sunlight produce ground-level ozone; studs wear road and create breathable particles; cold emission controls less effective.
sources.scope_limits: Stable qualitative mechanisms only; no historical fleet shares, diesel projections, exposure thresholds or claim outdoor CO never matters. CO and CO2 distinguished. Ground-level ozone forms via reactions, not simply directly emitted NOx.
sources.retrieval_method: Exact primary official page or PDF passage inspected with web tools

sources.title: Elfordon – så funkar det
sources.locator: Vad är ett elfordon?; Laddbara fordon och utsläpp av växthusgaser
sources.excerpt: Elhybridfordon är inte laddbara från elnätet.
sources.supports: BEV only electric; plug-in hybrid externally rechargeable, non-plug-in not; mining/manufacturing batteries/vehicles and electricity generation affect climate.
sources.scope_limits: Battery-electric car scoped explicitly; no-tailpipe follows directly from electricity-only propulsion, marked as explanatory inference in claims. No zero-lifecycle impact, fixed range, outdated inventory share or exact hybrid fuel-consumption promise.
sources.retrieval_method: Exact primary official page or PDF passage inspected with web tools

sources.title: Energi- och klimatrådgivning
sources.locator: Tänk efter vad du använder el till, motorvärmare bullet
sources.excerpt: Använd timer kopplar till motorvärmare och värm inte mer än nödvändigt
sources.supports: Timer limits unnecessary engine-heater electricity use.
sources.fallback_reason: TS/TRV timer searches and older Energimyndigheten nine-step lead did not give an accessible complete exact timer/energy teaching passage; current municipal advisory explicitly gives it.

sources.supports: AC increases fuel consumption but provides comfort/alertness and demisting safety benefits.

sources.title: Fuel efficient driving tips
sources.version: Live government agency page; editorial revision date not shown
sources.locator: Change up at low revs; Less stopping on a journey means less CO2
sources.excerpt: as soon as your vehicle will comfortably take the next higher gear
sources.supports: Early higher-gear choice limited by comfortable running, load/gradient; accelerator released while remaining in gear when slowing.
sources.fallback_reason: TS/TRV and older energy guide give early-upshift/motorbrake recommendations; inspected agency results lack complete suitably-engaged-gear definition and comfortable-running limit. VCA supplies these missing technical details.
sources.scope_limits: Conventional manual combustion-engine car only. Engine braking is editorial definition of described in-gear deceleration, not universal fuel cutoff. No fixed RPM, switching ignition off, foreign laws, downhill coasting or percentage saving imported.
sources.retrieval_method: Exact primary official page or PDF passage inspected with web tools

sources.title: Sparsam körning
sources.version: Live advisory page; no editorial revision date shown
sources.locator: Fördelar med sparsam körning / advice list: Minimera vikten och luftmotståndet
sources.excerpt: Lasta ur allt du inte behöver
sources.supports: Minimise mass and drag; unload unneeded cargo; mount roof equipment only when required.
sources.fallback_reason: TS economical-driving page covers roof racks/boxes; exact unnecessary carried-mass instruction was missing from inspected TS/TRV results. Swedish public energy-advisory service supplies it.
sources.scope_limits: Remove unnecessary cargo, retain required safety/accessibility equipment; no numerical fuel saving, no universal heater times from this page imported.
sources.retrieval_method: Exact primary official page or PDF passage inspected with web tools

sources.title: Tvätta bilen rätt
sources.version: Live municipal guidance; article revision date not shown (site-wide maintenance banner has its own unrelated date)
sources.locator: Opening; Så gör du rätt; Varför är det viktigt / För miljön
sources.excerpt: Där samlas och renas vattnet innan det släpps vidare.
sources.supports: Purpose-built automatic/self-service washes collect and treat dirty water; oil/metals/chemicals harm receiving waters; not all pollution eliminated.
sources.fallback_reason: TS/TRV car-washing searches did not give exact consumer wastewater-treatment instruction. Current municipal environmental authority guidance selected instead of older leaflet.
sources.scope_limits: Environmental choice, not invented nationwide blanket street-washing criminal rule. Local water-protection restrictions differ. Treatment does not guarantee zero pollution; use facility-compatible products.
sources.retrieval_method: Exact primary official page or PDF passage inspected with web tools

sources.title: Uppdrag att utreda när det ska vara tillåtet att använda dubbdäck

sources.supports: Municipality may restrict studded vehicles on road/segment/area; current statutory paragraph confirms authority.
sources.scope_limits: Use agency statement for authority; current statutory paragraph checked as corroboration only. No old fine, proposed date changes, historical municipal decision or particular street presented as currently operative.
sources.retrieval_method: Exact primary official page or PDF passage inspected with web tools

sources.supports: C44 denotes local studded-motor-vehicle restriction excluding moped class II unless supplement says otherwise.
sources.scope_limits: Text cross-link to already taught official C44 in M07-L02; no new image/design/sign placement. Check actual STFS decision, dates, limits, exceptions and signs; national permitted tyre season does not override local restriction.
